title: irvingia lobata
intro: Irvingia lobata, commonly known as African mango, is a plant species native to Central Africa and is a type of evergreen tree. The health benefits of Irvingia lobata include its potential to aid in weight loss, improve insulin sensitivity, and reduce cholesterol levels. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its ability to inhibit pancreatic lipase, suppress appetite, and regulate lipid metabolism. The bioactive constituents of Irvingia lobata include irvingin, irvingol, and other triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
